name: Morpheus
summary:
Your life is a series of familiar days, repeating the same routine.
Classes, thoughts, doubts… and the feeling of being stuck.

But one encounter changes everything.

In this visual novel, you will experience a story where every decision matters. Dialogues, choices, and even split-second reactions in tense moments will shape the course of events and your relationships with other characters.

You will meet people with their own struggles, fears, and goals. As you get to know them, you may begin to understand not only them — but yourself as well.
